title: Profile edit
description: A chapter member changes their display name and recovers from a failed save.

brief.user: A GDG chapter member updating how their name appears to other participants, on a phone or a laptop.
brief.goal: Change the display name, see that it was saved, and retry without retyping when saving fails.

args.outcome: accept | reject | hold — how the mocked save responds

artifact.testHooks: window.__profileSave = { calls, release() } exists only in the story to count and release mocked save requests.

data.longName: とても長い表示名の確認用テキストとして日本語の名前と所属コミュニティ名をつなげた文字列GDGTokyoOrganizerTeam
